note: Deterministic router over state/progress.json. Completion gate: (healthy_streak>=10 && total_findings>=20) || iteration>=20 => done (reason distinguishes health_criteria_met vs iteration_limit_reached). Otherwise routes to label equal to progress.status among {healthy,stale,pivot_required,attention_required}; missing/non-string/unknown status => attention_required. Numeric fields are NaN-safe (coerced to 0). Read errors / non-object payload => label 'error' (no exceptions thrown). No imports, no timers/random/network; only api.state.readJson used.
